newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns seen pricing Dart family deal-sources.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns seen pricing Dart family deal-sources.

text.p: Bear Stearns & Co Inc is expected on Wednesday to underwrite a deal via a private placement offering for the billionaire Dart family, market sources said.
The deal would represent the last existing Multi-Year Deposit Facility agreement (MYDFA) loans not subject to Brady bond restructuring, sources said.
Bear Stearns was unavailable for comment Tuesday.
MYDFAs were originally Brazilian loans before being converted into Bradies.
